title.zh: 将巴科洛德市西内格罗斯省立医院的名称变更为Corazon Locsin-Montelibano纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Occidental Negros Provincial Hospital in the City of Bacolod to Corazon Locsin-Montelibano Memorial Hospital.
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Occidental Negros Provincial Hospital in the City of Bacolod to Corazon Locsin-Montelibano Memorial Hospital.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6438_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Occidental Negros Provincial Hospital, situated in the City of Bacolod Philippines, is hereby changed and, henceforth, shall be named Corazon Locsin-Montelibano Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 17, 1972.
